crossRefs.note: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes black the day…
Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so the house of Israel is ashamed: they, their kings, their princes, their…
For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body…
Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed…
They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from…
for the great day of his wrath has come; and who is able to stand?”

translations.web: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.
translations.bsb: For to them, deep darkness is their morning; surely they are friends with the terrors of darkness!
translations.kjv: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.
translations.asv: For the morning is to all of them as thick darkness; For they know the terrors of the thick darkness.
